verdict.rationale: GitLab ships agentic features, so asking whether its agents can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The only MCP evidence describes the opposite direction: external MCP-compatible agents connecting to GitLab, which is the server role and does not transfer to this client story. No evidence shows GitLab registering or calling tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
